design_note: Frozen after v1's observed persistent-score undercoverage. Preserve v1 unchanged, use a new seed and report both bandwidths without selecting repetitions or cases. Integrated and learned-control experiments had no prior pilot output.
uncertainty: Bonferroni 95 percent whole-curve bands for responses; 95 percent scalar intervals for learned IV; report MC SE. Tuning illustrates a feasible learner and does not certify unobservable nuisance-rate assumptions.
failures: All 500 requested repetitions in denominator; retain numerical failures and invalid stationary-level analysis as adverse evidence.
